sources.title: Benelux modern photo-interpreted river and natural-water reference
sources.publisher: European Environment Agency / Copernicus Land Monitoring Service

access_metadata.source_crs: Product ETRS89-LAEA; service EPSG:3857; downloaded EPSG:4326
access_metadata.geometry: Photo-interpreted River_Net_l Strahler>=3 for all Ireland; InlandWater LKE_TYPE=N natural lakes >=0.25km². Not DEM drainage model.
access_metadata.attribution: Generated using European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service information; https://doi.org/10.2909/393359a7-7ebd-4a52-80ac-1a18d5f3db9c
access_metadata.historical_applicability: Modern reference; water levels, regulated natural lakes and banks not reconstructed for 1900
access_metadata.scope: Finite geographic Benelux and cross-border collar
access_metadata.persistence: HYP=1 and Strahler>=3; intermittent, ephemeral, dry and unknown excluded
access_metadata.interpretation: Current centre lines only; modern engineered mouths not automatically 1900 natural riverbanks.

sources.title: Kust 1905, digitised Zuiderzee chart wet/dry coastline
sources.publisher: Rijkswaterstaat; original chart held by Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed
sources.version: S. Mars chart revision 1905; RWS georeferenced digitisation as retrieved 2026-10-18

access_metadata.source_epoch: Chart revised 1905, NOT 2021 catalogue validity or 1900 exact survey
access_metadata.vertical_datum: No elevation used. Coast is chart dry/wet boundary, not current water level or depth.
access_metadata.scale_and_accuracy: Not quantified in supplied vector metadata; georeferenced historical map, not cadastral shoreline.
access_metadata.historical_applicability: Near-1900 visual reference only. Afsluitdijk and later polders absent; five-year chart/date difference remains.
access_metadata.production: Observed mainland shore and island perimeters; closure outside bounded display frame; original GIS retained. No political, topology, economy or ownership changes.
